name: San Adrián de Juarros (Spain)
description: Vertically divided yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Adrián de Juarros (a saint, a tree and a mountain on yellow and purple).
history: Municipal flag of San Adrián de Juarros; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: San Adrián de Juarros arms — saint, tree and mountain
